text:
maria: Heads up — after the runtime kernel-selector change (PR #842) I'm seeing multi-node TP runs intermittently hang in NCCL allgather. Happens on 8x A100 winston cluster, sequence length ~16k. One rank stays busy ~60-120s while others wait. Trying to repro, posting traces. /cc @jon

jon: any flamegraph or nvprof trace?

maria: uploaded a trace to s3: s3://redwood-perf/traces/1839123456/allgather-hang.json :eyes:
Here's the timeline excerpt that looks bad:
```
[rank 3] allgather: 0.12s -> 72.4s
[rank 7] allgather: 0.12s -> 0.13s
[rank 0] kernel exec mostly <10ms
```

kevin: that's suspicious — did the kernel-selector change the padding semantics for TP shards? I remember we toggled `prefer_fused_allgather` for small tensors in the last deploy.

maria: yes — selector now prefers fused kernels when `seq_len < 512`, but on TP shard boundaries the chunk sizes misalign so the fused path ends up sending a larger buffer (extra pad) for some ranks. That increases comm size for those shards.

sophia: could also be KV cache preemption. If headroom drops below threshold we serialize shards to host (memcpy) which can stall the GPU and block progress on the rank doing eviction. Combined with larger allgather this would amplify the lag.

jon: do you have the kvcache logs around the hang? also `nvidia-smi dmon` would show GPU utilization drops if kernels were blocked.

maria: pasted relevant logs from the run:
```
2026-03-16T14:02:10Z rank=3 INFO kvcache: evicting 2 shards (headroom=0.07)
2026-03-16T14:02:10Z rank=3 INFO kvcache: memcpy to host started (size=120MB)
2026-03-16T14:03:22Z rank=3 WARN runtime: allgather timeout after 65s
```

kevin: that looks like the combined cause — fused kernel increased per-rank message size, and rank 3 hit kvcache eviction which triggered a synchronous host memcpy. The memcpy + larger comm made rank3 slow and NCCL waits timed out. Could be a regression from the quantization/alignment change that changed tensor sizes.

sophia: quick mitigation: disable `prefer_fused_allgather` for TP and increase `kvcache.min_headroom` to 0.2 to avoid preempting during critical collective phases.

maria: confirmed locally — patched runtime config:
```
kernel_selector.prefer_fused_allgather=false
kvcache.min_headroom=0.2
```
Reran the same 8-node TP workload 3x, no hangs. Pushing a small fix and a rollback candidate in PR #858.

perf-bot: CI perf-run 1839123501 failed (timeout) — job: https://ci.redwood/example/jobs/1839123501 :frowning:

jon: assigning kernel selector triage to @kevin; I'll follow up on KV cache tuning and a safe default in the runtime.

kevin: I'll run targeted microbenchmarks comparing fused vs unfused allgather across shard sizes (64KB -> 2MB) and collect NCCL traces + flamegraphs, will post results to the trace S3 and link here.

maria: thanks — timeline + logs in s3, PR #858 contains the config rollback. Repro steps in the PR description. :( :face_with_monocle:

kevin: thanks, I'll dig in and try to build a deterministic unit test for the selector behavior. :thumbsup:
